archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Tailored for B2B SaaS / Dashboard)

layout.spacing_system: Dense & structured (Dashboard standard: p-4, p-6 for cards, gap-4)
layout.page_structure: Left dual-sidebar (Dark primary + White secondary) + Top Header (White) + Main Canvas (Light Grey)
layout.grid_system: Bento-style Control Room (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6)

kpi_card.style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md p-5 shadow-sm
kpi_card.typography: Label text-slate-500 text-sm font-medium, Value text-3xl text-slate-900 font-semibold

button_primary.style: bg-[#2196F3] text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium text-sm shadow-sm

button_secondary.style: bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium text-sm

table.header: bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 font-medium py-3 px-4 border-b border-slate-200

badge.pro: bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
badge.perso: bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium

sidebar_item.primary: text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 p-3 rounded-lg flex justify-center items-center cursor-pointer transition-colors
sidebar_item.primary_active: text-[#2196F3] bg-slate-800 p-3 rounded-lg flex justify-center items-center
sidebar_item.secondary: text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 rounded-md flex items-center text-sm font-medium transition-colors
sidebar_item.secondary_active: text-[#2196F3] bg-blue-50 px-3 py-2 rounded-md flex items-center text-sm font-medium

icons_and_assets.icon_style: Solid/Duotone for primary sidebar, Regular for UI elements
icons_and_assets.avatar_placeholder: Use a generic highly-readable initial avatar (e.g. 'A')

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'IBM Plex Sans' and 'IBM Plex Mono' in the HTML head or via CSS import.

Set up the layout precisely: The leftmost sidebar should be very narrow (w-20 or w-16) and very dark (bg-slate-900). The secondary sidebar immediately to its right should be white (bg-white) and contain the 'Livre de bord' sub-menu items. The header runs horizontally at the top, over the content area, but right of the primary sidebar.
The primary CTA buttons should strictly use the Logitrak Blue (#2196F3).
Use Recharts for the KPI charts (Pro vs Perso breakdown pie chart).
Add the red accent to the Logitrak logo (the 'i' dot).
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items, table rows) have a descriptive `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case.
Mock data should simulate Navixy track history (e.g., depart address, arrival address, distance km, duration, pro/perso status).
